_readme: US-ENTRY / EXPANSION MODEL layer (Pro / intelligence tier). How each tracked China-origin
chain actually entered and scales in the US. NOT a public datum yet — surfaced via the
`entry-models` CLI and Pro export; keep out of the public map/register until decided.
direct_subsidiary  - the brand's own US entity runs company-owned stores; no US franchising
us_franchise       - an open US franchise program (FDD or first-party application)
regional_operators - several independent US operators each run a cluster; no single national entity
importer_group     - a US multi-brand venture that imports the brand (e.g. Chubby Group)
authorized_partner - a single authorized flagship/licensee via a local partner
distribution       - not branded retail (wholesale / gray-market); usually out of the outlet count
unknown            - US-present but the entry mechanism is not yet established (needs research)
confidence = high (explicit first-party/FDD/press evidence), medium (strong inference), low.
`operators` = US ventures that run one or more China brands; importer_group ones are the headline.
Only chains with US outlets are classified. as_of 2026-11-13.

chubby_group.name: Chubby Group
chubby_group.principal: David Zhao (co-founded 2016 w/ Haibin Yang & Joyce Li)
chubby_group.other: Also a Japanese import (Chubby Tan = Japan's Gyutan no Lemon, US distributor) + US-created concepts (Chubby Cattle, Wagyu House, The X Pot, Niku X, Chubby Bowls) — out of scope.
chubby_group.note: The clearest example of a US venture specializing in bringing China-origin chains to America. Watch for further China-brand US entries.

jiumaojiu.name: Jiumaojiu International (九毛九)
jiumaojiu.note: The Chinese parent operating its own brand's US stores directly (not a third-party importer).

super_hi.name: Super Hi International
super_hi.note: Haidilao's own overseas arm; US stores company-owned.

yum_china.name: Yum China
yum_china.note: Owns Little Sheep; re-entered the US (American Dream NJ).
